Application Data.NAME: Smith Appliance Solutions
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith Appliance Solutions specializes in the retail sale and repair of home appliances, including refrigerators, washers, dryers, and cooking equipment. Our operations include sourcing and selling both new and refurbished appliances, providing expert repair services, and offering warranty support to our customers. We thrive on maintaining high-quality standards and have established rigorous inspection and testing protocols for all refurbished appliances to ensure safety and reliability. Our showroom showcases a wide variety of products, and our experienced technicians are well-trained in the latest repair techniques. Additionally, we implement strict security measures to safeguard our high-value inventory, ensuring a safe and reliable experience for our customers.
